Name: Cozy Farm Computer for Alternative Textures
Author: hypnagogie
Description:
I have a little ritual where I sit down one day a week and drink a coffee and sort my inventory.  The regular farm computer was not matching my cozy vibe, so I made a texture that fit what was in my imagination.

This is my first attempt at making any kind of mod, so I hope it brings some joy to anyone who finds it. :) I was heavily inspired by Atlas' West Elm furniture, Elegant Craftables, and Gwen's Craftables, all of whom are miles beyond my tiny foray into pixel art, but I hope my little contribution sits well next to theirs. 

To use this mod, first install Alternative Textures, then install this mod.  In the game, you buy a paint bucket from Robin's shop, equip it and click on the item you want to change the texture for (in this case, the farm computer).
